mechanism: Designates one main pair as signal provider (RSI<30 buy / RSI>70 sell). For each other symbol, compares SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE and SYMBOL_CURRENCY_PROFIT to a Base_Quote (e.g. USD): if quote==Base open same-direction trade; if base==Base open opposite trade. Encodes FX inverse/direct correlation from currency-role structure rather than rolling statistics.
data_needed: Comma-separated symbol list; Base_Quote currency string; Currency_Main index; RSI(14) handles per symbol; PERIOD_CURRENT bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD,GBPUSD,USDCAD,USDJPY (inputs); PERIOD_CURRENT; same-base groups e.g. EURUSD/EURGBP/EURJPY
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a lightweight structural FX-correlation sensor from base/quote roles that can gate multi-pair exposure without computing a full correlation matrix.
quote: When GBPUSD moves up (Bullish), USDCAD often moves down (bearish). This happens because in the first pair (GBPUSD), the USD is the quote currency, while in the second pair (USDCAD), the USD is the base currency.

mechanism: Per symbol on H1: zscore=(close-MA)/StdDev; momentum=close-close[N]; momThreshold=Mom_Threshold*stddev. Flags meanReversionLong/Short at |z|≥Z_Threshold and momentumLong/Short when |momentum|≥momThreshold. Priority: both aligned → RiskPercent_High; momentum-only → Mod; mean-reversion-only → Low. Dual regime sensor for trend vs reversion.
data_needed: MA, StdDev, ATR handles per symbol; MAPeriod; MomentumPeriod; Z_Threshold; Mom_Threshold; H1 closes.
why_new_for_mis: Combines Z-score dislocation and volatility-scaled momentum into one multi-pair regime sensor with explicit priority when both agree—usable as MIS entry-regime tags.
quote: The signal logic is tiered, giving priority to cases where both mean reversion and momentum align in the same direction, assigning them the highest risk allocation

mechanism: Instead of fixed pip momentum cutoff, momThreshold = Mom_Threshold * current StdDev so the momentum gate auto-scales with local volatility; same StdDev also drives Z-score. Makes momentum detection volatility-aware across heterogeneous pairs.
data_needed: StdDev(MAPeriod) buffer; Mom_Threshold input; close and close[MomentumPeriod].
why_new_for_mis: Provides a cross-asset comparable momentum sensor by measuring price change in units of rolling sigma rather than raw pips.
quote: A dynamic momentum threshold is also computed by scaling the standard deviation, making the system responsive to changing volatility conditions.

mechanism: CopyBuffer last 20 ATR values; avgATR=mean; if currentATR>1.5*avgATR → RiskPercent_High; if currentATR<0.5*avgATR → RiskPercent_Low; else Mod. Classifies each symbol into high/moderate/low volatility regime for sizing.
data_needed: ATR handle per symbol; 20-bar ATR history; three RiskPercent_* inputs.
why_new_for_mis: Simple relative-ATR regime tag (spike vs quiet vs normal) MIS can attach per instrument without a full GARCH stack.
quote: if it’s significantly higher (above 1.5×), the market is considered highly volatile and the higher risk percentage is used; if it’s much lower (below 0.5×), the lower risk percentage is applied.

mechanism: V-Stop = typical price (H+L+C)/3 ± ATR_Multiplier*ATR. Upper/lower bands filter RSI entries (sell if RSI overbought and bid < upper; buy if oversold and ask > lower) and supply historical TP lookback plus ATR trailing. Volatility envelope as support/resistance sensor.
data_needed: ATR, high/low/close at shift; ATR_Multiplier; optional 50-bar V-Stop history for TP.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a per-symbol volatility-band level sensor (V-Stop) usable for regime/break filters beyond raw ATR.
quote: Depending on whether the upper or lower V-Stop is needed (isUpper flag), it adds or subtracts a multiple of the ATR from this typical price to generate a volatility-adjusted support or resistance level

mechanism: ENUM_MODE Scalp vs Swing: Scalp uses M5 EMA5/20 cross + tight RSI 55/45; Swing uses H4 swing high/low lookback, Fib 0.618 retracement, optional D1 EMA20 trend gate. Same EA switches horizon/structure sensors by mode—frames short-horizon vs swing-regime sensing.
data_needed: TradeMode; ScalpTimeframe/SwingTimeframe; EMA/RSI handles; Swing_Lookback; Fib_Level; HigherTF EMA.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD,BTCUSD,US100,GBPUSD; Scalp M5/M3; Swing H4 + D1 confirmation
why_new_for_mis: Documents explicit dual-horizon sensing (micro-momentum vs Fib structure+HTF bias) as selectable MIS regime channels on mixed assets.
quote: By allowing the trader to switch between or automate these modes based on market volatility and structure, the EA can adapt its trade logic, stop levels, and time horizons dynamically.

mechanism: Per symbol: spreadInPips from ask-bid; atrValue=ATR(H1,14); spreadATRRatio=spread/ATR. Disable if spread>MaxAbsoluteSpread (timeout DisableTimeoutSec) or if UseAdaptiveFilter and ratio>MaxSpreadATRRatio. RankSymbolsBySpread score=0.6/(1+spread)+0.4/(1+ratio); activate only top MaxActiveSymbols. Liquidity/cost microstructure router.
data_needed: Live bid/ask; H1 ATR(14); MaxAbsoluteSpread; MaxSpreadATRRatio; MaxActiveSymbols; timer updates.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD,GBPUSD,XAUUSD,US100,BTCUSD; TradingTimeframe M5; ATR on H1 for ratio
why_new_for_mis: Turns spread and spread/ATR into a live multi-symbol liquidity eligibility and ranking sensor—core MIS execution-quality gate.
quote: Unlike traditional single-symbol EAs, this system implements intelligent spread filtering that temporarily disables symbols experiencing abnormally high spreads, preventing costly entries during poor liquidity conditions while automatically re-enabling them when spreads normalize.

mechanism: On new CorrTimeframe bar (or timer): CopyClose CorrelationPeriod bars per symbol; Pearson corr for all pairs into flattened n×n matrix. Before execute, PassesCorrelationFilter: if |corr|≥CorrelationThreshold and correlated symbol has open position, block same-direction trades when corr>0 and opposite-direction when corr<0 (inverse stacking). Real-time correlation as portfolio exposure sensor.
data_needed: Close series CorrTimeframe length CorrelationPeriod; CorrelationThreshold (e.g. 0.7); open position directions.
why_new_for_mis: Embeds rolling Pearson inter-market correlation as a live MIS sensing layer that can veto redundant directional exposure across pairs.
quote: Trades are blocked if highly correlated symbols already have positions in the same or inverse direction, depending on the correlation sign.

mechanism: GetBias: change=(close[0]-close[BiasLookbackBars])/close[lookback]; return +1 if change>BiasThreshold (default 0.1%), −1 if <−BiasThreshold, else 0. Percentage lookback bias as short-horizon directional change sensor alongside MA crossover.
why_new_for_mis: Simple percent-change bias flag MIS can use as a lightweight directional-change sensor independent of indicator crosses.
quote: If price appreciation exceeds the threshold, the function returns a bullish signal (1); if depreciation exceeds it negatively, it returns bearish (−1); otherwise, it remains neutral (0).

mechanism: Maps broker hour to SESSION_ASIAN/LONDON/NEWYORK/OFF; each session has own activeSymbols list and risk budget (equal-split or manual % of DailyCapitalPercent). Only session-active symbols trade; daily/session usedRisk tracked and reset at midnight. Time-of-day regime as capital and universe sensor.
data_needed: Session start/end hours; Asian/London/NY symbol lists; DailyCapitalPercent; allocation mode.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD,GBPUSD,USDJPY,USDZAR; Asia: USDJPY,XAUUSD; London: GBPUSD; NY: XAUUSD,USDZAR; M15 ATR/range
why_new_for_mis: Treats Asia/London/NY as distinct market regimes with different instrument universes—directly usable as MIS session-regime tags.
quote: each trading session has a distinct personality, volatility profile, and edge characteristics.

mechanism: Session high/low from M15 lookback; upperVolatilityStop=sessionHigh+ATR*mult, lower=sessionLow−ATR*mult. On break of session high: if ask≥upperVolatilityStop → genuine long breakout; else fade short. Symmetric for lows. ATR-confirmed breakout authenticity sensor.
data_needed: Session high/low; ATR(M15); ATRMultiplier; optional SessionFormationMinutes gate.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Session-active symbols; PERIOD_M15 range and ATR
why_new_for_mis: Separates genuine volatility-expanding breakouts from false range wicks via ATR-extended session levels—MIS change/break authenticity sensor.
quote: when price clears the volatility stop (session high/low plus ATR multiplier), the strategy trades in the breakout direction; when it fails to clear, it fades the move.

mechanism: Per-symbol tick buffer + spread history: flags noisy if spread>avgSpread*MaxSpreadMultiplier, tickVelocity>MaxTickVelocity, bid gap>MaxGapPoints, microVolatility outside [Min,Max]VolatilityPoints, or slippageEstimate>SlippageStabilityFactor. Gate: tradable=!noisy before any strategy signal.
data_needed: Tick bid/ask circular buffer; spread history; MaxSpreadMultiplier; MaxTickVelocity; MaxGapPoints; VolatilitySampleTicks; SlippageStabilityFactor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD,GBPUSD,USDJPY,USDZAR; tick-time; ATR H1 for strategy SL; swing lookback H1
why_new_for_mis: Packages spread, tick velocity, quote gaps, micro-vol, and slippage into a first-class MIS liquidity/execution-quality sensing stack.
quote: It verifies spread, tick velocity, recent quote gaps, and micro-volatility stability. Only when all questions return clean answers does the system evaluate the trading signal itself.

mechanism: ClassifyMarketState: spreadSpike+tickBurst→HIGH_RISK_NEWS; highSlippage/spreadSpike→EXECUTION_UNSTABLE; lowTick→THIN_LIQUIDITY; choppyVol→NOISY_CHOP; else CLEAN_BREAKOUT if microVol>0.5*ATR else CLEAN_TREND. UpdateQualityScore 0–100 from spread/velocity/vol/slippage penalties and state bonuses. Regime labels for execution environment.
data_needed: Spread/velocity/gap/microVol/slippage stats; ATR; quality score thresholds (~55 live / 50 tester).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same multi-pair FX/metal set; timer-driven classification
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS discrete execution-regime labels plus a continuous quality score beyond simple volatility regimes.
quote: The EA does not predict direction. It predicts whether the market can currently fill an order without destroying the edge.

mechanism: UpdateMicroVolatility: last N midprices from tick buffer; returns=(p[i+1]-p[i])/point; microVolatility=stdev(returns). Feeds noise band and state classifier. Ultra-short-horizon volatility from ticks not bars.
data_needed: Tick midprice buffer length ≥VolatilitySampleTicks (default 20); point size.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Per-symbol tick stream; sample window in ticks
why_new_for_mis: Defines a tick-scale volatility sensor MIS can use for microstructure regime and execution gates.
quote: We then compute the mean and variance of these returns to derive a micro volatility measurement that reflects short-term price instability.

mechanism: From ≥500–1000 H1 bars: atr, stddev of Δclose, avgRange/Body/wicks, noiseRatio=avgBody/avgRange, trendPersistence=avg run length, avgPullback, gapFrequency (gaps>0.3*ATR per 100 bars), atrDispersion=CV of true range, relVolPct=100*atr/avgClose. Classifies VOL_LOW..EXTREME, NOISE_*, TREND_PERSISTENT/MIXED/CHOPPY, MOMO_STRONG/WEAK. Per-pair volatility personality sensor, relearned every InpUpdateBars.
data_needed: CopyRates InpHistoryBars on InpTimeframe (H1); ≥500 bars; update every InpUpdateBars (100).
why_new_for_mis: Rich multi-feature volatility fingerprint and regime labels per instrument—strong MIS volatility/regime feature set beyond single ATR.
quote: This statistical fingerprint captures noise, trend persistence, pullback depth, and range dispersion. A classification engine then labels each pair by its market personality.

mechanism: ComputeRiskProfile: noiseFactor=Clamp(0.80+(1-noiseRatio)*0.80,0.8,1.5); pullbackFactor from avgPullback/atr; trendFactor 0.85/1.20/1.00 by TREND class; spreadFactor from spread/atr; volFactor from atrDispersion. slMultiplier=Clamp(base*∏factors, min, max); live SL=liveATR*slMultiplier. Maps signature into adaptive volatility distance.
data_needed: Completed VolatilitySignature; live ATR; bid/ask spread; InpBase/Min/MaxMultiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same four symbols on H1; MACD+EMA200 signal layer independent
why_new_for_mis: Shows how MIS can turn multi-factor volatility signatures into instrument-specific distance/regime parameters rather than one global ATR mult.
quote: Live SL distance uses the current ATR, not the historical mean, so the distance adapts intrabar-regime while the multiplier is the slow-moving "personality" component.
